// Part: room: powder room (interior furnisher + lamplighter). Inner air x63..68, y4..9, z54..60.
// Door from the east corridor at z53 (x65..66). Focal piece: the washstand on the south wall (z60), basin and mirror
// facing the door. Chair (stairs) at z59 facing it, a 3x3 rug in the middle, a barrel with a pot in the north-east
// corner, a hanging lantern over the rug and a standing lantern on the floor at the south-west of the rug. The west doorway (x62, z56..57) and the south windows (x65..66, z61) stay clear.
import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";

export function build(g) {
  const legend = {
    B: "barrel",
    F: "flower_pot",
    W: "white_carpet",
    S: ["dark_oak_stairs", { facing: "north", half: "bottom" }],
    K: "dark_oak_planks",
    C: "water_cauldron",
    G: "glass_pane",
    I: "iron_bars",
    L: ["lantern", { hanging: "true" }],
    T: ["lantern", { hanging: "false" }],
  };
  // rows run along +x (x63..68), successive rows along +z (z54..60); one layer per y (y4..y9)
  const EMPTY = "......";
  layers(g, [63, 4, 54], legend, [
    // y4 floor: barrel NE corner, rug x64..66 z56..58, chair z59, washstand cabinet x63..64 z60
    [".....B", EMPTY, ".WWW..", ".WWW..", ".TWW..", ".S....", "KK...."],
    // y5: pot on the barrel, water basin and a pot on the washstand
    [".....F", EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, "CF...."],
    // y6..7: mirror panes on the wall behind the basin
    [EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, "GG...."],
    [EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, "GG...."],
    // y8: iron bar cornice over the mirror
    [EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, "II...."],
    // y9: hanging lantern over the rug (the upper floor at y10 is the hanging block)
    [EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, "..L...", EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY],
  ]);
}

content.text: The cause is systemic, not in this part. `shell.mjs:27` fills every interior cell of the main block with `air`, and `runParts` counts any cell an earlier part wrote as owned, air included. So every interior cell of the powder room is locked. All 23 of room-10's writes fall inside that box (the layers count is 23, and 0 placed), so "remove or move those writes" removes the whole furnishing. I'll read the file, then keep the design rows as data and leave `build()` writing nothing. I won't bypass the lock.

input.summary:
Powder room (room-10.mjs): its 23 furnishing writes were all refused because shell.mjs carves the whole interior to air and runParts locks air-owned cells. The layout is kept as data (LEGEND, LAYERS) and build() writes nothing, so make.sh shows "0 placed" with no REFUSED and no OFF-PALETTE for this part, and build.nbt is written.
The room is bare: barrel, pot, rug, washstand, basin, mirror panes, iron cornice, chair and lanterns are not in the build.
Fixing it needs a change outside this module: runParts should let writes through into cells that are only air, or the shell should stop claiming interior air.
left: The powder room is empty: none of its furniture, rug, mirror or lanterns are in build.nbt. parts/room-10.mjs keeps the layout as LEGEND/LAYERS data but build() writes nothing.

Root cause is outside this module: shell.mjs:27 fills every interior cell with air (box() in the outer-walls section), and the runParts lock in build.mjs (write(), around lines 213-221) treats those air cells as owned, so any room part's writes are refused. The same error appears in 13 other room/part outputs: entrance hall (42 refused), parlour library (64), dining room (46), butler's pantry (24), kitchen (31), bedroom 3 (28), bedroom 5 (21), bedroom 6 (21), ground gallery (2), cottage bath (2), gazebo (4), greenhouse (7). Fixing it needs an owner decision in runParts or shell.mjs.
Once the lock is fixed, restore the layers(g, [63, 4, 54], LEGEND, LAYERS) call in build(). The palette was not flagged for this part, so no changes are needed there.

Unrelated to this part, but in the same build: the mansion shell reports off-palette roof blocks from roof.json (tuff_brick_slab, tuff_bricks, cobbled_deepslate_stairs, tuff_brick_stairs, cobbled_deepslate_slab, polished_deepslate_slab, polished_deepslate_stairs, stone_brick_slab) that another part must swap.

waste.what: Working out why all 23 writes were refused: I read shell.mjs and the runParts write() lock in the library to learn that the shell's air carve is what claims the cells. The refusal line only says 'had: air' and never names the owning part.
waste.cost: about 4 tool calls and roughly 60 lines of library source read
waste.tool: runParts' REFUSED line should name the owning part and call out air-only ownership (e.g. 'owned by mansion shell as air, shell.mjs:27'), or a `mcd owners build.nbt --cell x,y,z` command should report it.

waste.what: Confirming that all 23 writes were refused, by counting the non-dot characters in the layer rows by hand, because the refusal list is capped at 8 entries (refusedAt.slice(0, 8)).
waste.cost: one manual count plus a full make.sh run to compare
waste.tool: layers() dry-run (or `mcd plan --part <name>`) that reports, per layer, cells to write, cells refused and the owning part; and an uncapped refused list in parts-report.json.

waste.what: Checking whether the same lock problem hit other rooms, which I had to do by reading the full make.sh output by hand.
waste.cost: one make.sh run and a manual scan of 13 REFUSED lines
waste.tool: a summary line at the end of make.sh that totals refused writes per owner (e.g. 'shell air claims 300+ interior cells: 13 parts refused').

companions.task: Build the washstand cabinet, the stairs chair and the dark-oak trim once the interior is free for the furniture to go in.
Set the mirror panes and the iron-bar cornice above them on the south wall, flush with the washstand.
